purpose: Review and manage vehicle-specific opt-in private cohort benchmarking, privacy accounting, stable releases, noisy comparisons and revocation.
primaryGoal: Make an informed participation decision, create or check a private release, interpret its limitations, and revoke future contributions with typed confirmation.

dataSources.name: Selected vehicle
dataSources.behavior: URL vehicle_id takes precedence over persisted selection and first fleet vehicle; known-vehicle validation and URL repair reside in the shared hook. Fleet loading and failure are not exposed by the page's chosen destructuring.

dataSources.name: Privacy status
dataSources.behavior: Enabled for truthy vehicle ID; status query key includes vehicle ID; ANALYTICS stale time and abort signal forwarding. deriveDataState feeds participation, budget and controls; missing opted_in is locally defaulted to false.
dataSources.backendLimits: Only route registration inspected; no handler, DB, differential-privacy guarantees, subject isolation or runtime response verified.

dataSources.name: Historical releases
dataSources.behavior: Enabled only for selected vehicle and confirmed opted-in status; query key includes vehicle, limit and offset; abort signal and ANALYTICS stale time. Page chooses items[0], with historical provenance, and exposes no release-history paging UI.
dataSources.backendLimits: Ordering of items, window calculation, nullable payload conformity and stability/idempotency are unverified. Do not infer items[0] is newest from a backend implementation not read.

dataSources.name: Opt in
dataSources.behavior: Successful response populates selected-vehicle status and invalidates benchmark root queries.

dataSources.name: Create/check release
dataSources.request: Page supplies only vehicle_id; hook supports optional period_end but page supplies none.
dataSources.behavior: Invalidates status and benchmark root after success. Stable-release reuse and last-three-completed-months statements are UI explanations, not independently proved server behavior.

dataSources.name: Revoke participation
dataSources.behavior: Removes benchmark root queries and invalidates selected status on success; typed localized REVOKE confirmation precedes mutation. No mutation executed.

components.name: PageLayout / LayoutCard / Grid
components.contract: PageLayout delegates to PageContainer and keeps w-full/min-w-0 container; LayoutCard supplies named title, actions, description help and footer. Grid callers request one column then lg two columns, gap 4. Preserve independent sources and all section reachability.
components.limits: Grid and PageContainer implementation not inspected; inherited retry chrome, sizing and runtime shell behavior unverified.

components.name: Seven benchmark sections and BenchmarkStatusContent
components.contract: Reuse existing section components. BenchmarkStatusContent composes SourceContent with fatalError, loading and retry, plus StaleRefreshWarning. Keep status-backed sections separate from release-backed sections.

components.name: OperationalBrief / UsageCard
components.contract: OperationalBrief accepts typed metrics, compact, source-backed status, scope, freshness, provenance, narrative and loading; preserves details drawer and missing-value states. UsageCard budget takes headline/rightLabel/caption/pct/intent/ariaLabel, with unknown-budget emptyMessage. Calculations stay in feature adapters.
components.limits: Drawer/focus, formatter implementation and complete shared-component internals not audited.

components.name: ChartCard / chart category
components.contract: Existing frame delegates to EmbeddedChart with ariaLabel, data/dataColumns, exportable, loading, empty and explicit 280px height. Metric labels and percentiles remain accessible/exportable through the frame. Static CHART_COLORS[0] resolves to Okabe-Ito blue, not the optional neon palette.
components.limits: EmbeddedChart, real export interaction and accessible-data UI not executed or inspected deeply.

components.name: Button / Checkbox / ConfirmDialog / Table / typography / feedback / FadeIn
components.owner: existing category barrels; no new primitive owner required
components.contract: Keep labeled controls, localized error callouts, semantic row headers, action loading/disabled behavior, confirmation cancel and typed token, and shared entrance-motion policy.
components.limits: No primitive implementations, real keyboard order, focus restoration, target sizes or reduced-motion runtime verified.

duplicatedPatterns.fix: Evaluate existing composed/embedded presentation with the shared owner; retain OperationalBrief metrics, drawer, provenance and full descriptions, not delete a summary to reduce noise.

observedSourceBehavior.noVehicle: One Select a vehicle LayoutCard with /vehicles navigation; all seven domain sections are absent in this branch (page:70-80). Preserve the branch and navigation.
observedSourceBehavior.initialStatus: deriveDataState initial; BenchmarkStatusContent renders loading for absent source data, wrapping consent, UsageCard and revoke. Budget OperationalBrief also uses initial loading.
observedSourceBehavior.optedOut: Consent acknowledgement and opt-in shown; releases disabled; CohortEligibilityPanel explains consent; comparison metrics remain unknown and chart empty; revoke disabled.
observedSourceBehavior.loadingReleases: Cohort skeleton, comparison OperationalBrief loading, ChartCard loading.
observedSourceBehavior.emptyRelease: Cohort create action, unavailable metric summaries/empty explanation, no charted percentiles.
observedSourceBehavior.suppressed: Cohort warning; per-metric suppressed descriptions; chart filters suppressed or missing percentiles. Suppression reasons remain present.
observedSourceBehavior.statusFailure: Status-backed SourceContent fatal error and retry; other sections remain mounted.
observedSourceBehavior.releaseFailure: Error forwarded to cohort callout; comparison status becomes release unavailable; chart only receives null release/loading, no source error.
observedSourceBehavior.staleOrOfflineRetained: deriveDataState keeps payload for error/paused; status sections and metric comparison have StaleRefreshWarning; cohort/chart lack local DataState, while PageLayout receives both queries.
observedSourceBehavior.mutations: Consent pending/error; create pending/error; revoke disabled pending, localized typed confirmation, cancel and close-on-confirm, with error callout after mutation.

issues.detail: Cohort receives optedIn=false while status is unresolved or failed; releases are disabled and it can report Consent required before participation is known. The default threshold 5 at line 102 can appear before accounting resolves. Chart receives no fatal/retained state at line 119 and can say empty on release failure.
issues.fix: Keep known false distinct from unknown and pass existing status/release DataState into affected sections; distinguish disabled, pending, fatal, empty and retained data without removing current content or introducing a second query engine.

issues.detail: No-release EmptyState action only receives onCreate, not pending/disabled. Pending is used on the existing-release Button at line 116, but not on initial Create release. Repeated clicks appear possible while the create mutation is pending; actual duplicate requests not executed.
issues.fix: Compose the existing Button loading/disabled contract for initial create while preserving the same EmptyState explanation and action. Do not claim server idempotency.

issues.detail: All absent data without fatalError maps to loading, including paused initial requests. SourceContent receives no separate offline/unavailable classification here; StaleRefreshWarning may communicate some blocked state but its implementation was not inspected.
issues.fix: Use existing DataState blocked/unknown state presentation after checking SourceContent and warning contracts; preserve retry and retained values.

states.runtime: All state cases source-only; no request or mutation performed.

visualIssues.detail: Budget bar uses fixed bg-cyan-500/70 (or amber/red at warning thresholds) and its rail uses bg-white/[0.06] at line 248. This page consumes the budget branch. These are shared fixed-color saturation/white-overlay risks, not proof of fluorescent output or pure-white text. Page/domain source scan found no neon/glow/white tokens.
visualIssues.fix: Shared owner should bind existing budget intents and rail to semantic theme tokens, preserving percentages, epsilon values, severity thresholds, accessible summary and over-budget semantics. Do not reset saved theme/chart choices.

architectureIssues.detail: Benchmarks prefix disables workspace vehicle control (scope computation at 156-166). Page mutations/read queries require a selected vehicle but page has no local selector or visible selected-vehicle identity. Desktop WorkspaceHeader only renders VehiclePicker when showVehicle (34,62-67); useSelectedVehicle can silently use persisted or first fleet vehicle. This is a source-confirmed scope/identity gap; mobile shell and real route behavior not exercised.
architectureIssues.fix: Integration owner should make a deliberate route-specific workspace scope decision and expose existing vehicle selection plus target identity, or preserve an appropriate existing local selector if header intentionally remains hidden. Never add a competing workspace store. Retain URL/store/first-vehicle precedence and authenticated consent boundaries.

architectureIssues.detail: Acknowledgement is page-local state with no reset/key on vehicleId change. If workspace or URL scope changes without remount, an acknowledgement from one vehicle can remain checked for another. This is a source risk; actual routing/remount behavior unverified.
architectureIssues.fix: Keep explicit acknowledgement tied to the current target vehicle when scope changes; preserve checkbox copy, opt-in request and existing cache invalidation.

priority.reason: Vehicle identity/selection and unknown-versus-opted-out semantics affect informed consent and recovery; resolve before cosmetic changes. Existing shared layout and domain decomposition already provide a strong reuse baseline.
